description: Java source code for an example Spark SQL data source application, demonstrating reading/writing various data formats, schema merging, and dataset operations.

classes.name: JavaSQLDataSourceExample
classes.description: Main class demonstrating Spark SQL data source operations.

classes.name: Square
classes.description: Serializable class representing a square with value and square fields.

classes.name: Cube
classes.description: Serializable class representing a cube with value and cube fields.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method initializing SparkSession and executing example data source operations.

methods.name: runGenericFileSourceOptionsExample
methods.description: Demonstrates reading parquet files with options like ignore corrupt files, recursive lookup, glob filter, and time-based filters.

methods.name: runBasicDataSourceExample
methods.description: Shows loading and saving data with various formats and options, including SQL queries and table operations.

methods.name: runBasicParquetExample
methods.description: Reads, writes, and queries parquet files, demonstrating schema preservation.

methods.name: runParquetSchemaMergingExample
methods.description: Creates and merges schemas from multiple parquet files with different columns.

methods.name: runJsonDatasetExample
methods.description: Reads JSON datasets, creates views, and runs SQL queries.

methods.name: runCsvDatasetExample
methods.description: Reads CSV datasets with various options and demonstrates reading multiple files.

methods.name: runTextDatasetExample
methods.description: Reads text datasets with options for line separator and whole text reading.

methods.name: runJdbcDatasetExample
methods.description: Demonstrates reading from and writing to JDBC sources.

methods.name: runXmlDatasetExample
methods.description: Reads XML datasets with options and runs SQL queries.
